items.title: repercussion
items.body: 专八高频学术名词，指(常指负面的)连锁反应、深远影响，通常以复数形式 repercussions 出现。例句：The sudden resignation of the CEO had serious repercussions throughout the entire industry. CEO 的突然辞职在整个行业引发了严重的连锁反应。写作替换：不要只会用 influence 或 result，可写 far-reaching repercussions（深远影响）、unforeseen repercussions（难以预料的后果）。搭配注意：repercussions for...（对……的后果）/ repercussions of...（……引发的后果）。

items.title: quintessential
items.body: 形容词，意为「最典型的、最精髓的典范」，语气比 typical 更强，强调某物是某类事物的最高代表。例句：The teahouse in the old alley is the quintessential Chengdu experience — bamboo chairs, loose tea, and endless gossip. 老街巷里的茶馆是最典型的成都体验——竹椅、盖碗茶、摆不完的龙门阵。写作搭配：the quintessential example of... / a quintessential symbol of...。发音：/ˌkwɪntɪˈsenʃl/，注意中间 /tɪ/ 轻读，结尾的 /əl/ 不要发成「欧」。

items.title: 自然结束对话的3个口语句型
items.body: 1. "I’d better let you go — I know you’ve got a lot on your plate."（不耽误你了，我知道你忙）2. "I won’t keep you any longer, but it was great catching up!"（不再耽搁，聊得很开心）3. "Let’s leave it there for now — I’ll shoot you a text later."（先聊到这，晚点发你消息）。连读难点：got a lot on your plate 中 on your 弱读为 /ɒnjə/；shoot you a 中 /t/ + /j/ 同化为 /tʃ/，读作 /ʃuːtʃə/。使用场景：线上会议收尾、电梯偶遇、语音通话结束。建议先听原速模仿语调，再0.75倍速抠连读细节。

items.title: 餐厅沟通：投诉与解决的完整对话
items.body: A: "Excuse me, I hate to be a bother, but we’ve been waiting for over forty minutes and this isn’t what we ordered." B: "I sincerely apologize. Let me comp your appetizer and rush the correct order — it’ll be out in five minutes, on the house." 实用表达：hate to be a bother（礼貌开场，降低攻击性）；comp（verb. 免单/赠送，餐厅高频动词）；on the house（店家请客）。语音重点：sincerely /sɪnˈsɪəli/ 中间不要吞音；appetizer /ˈæpɪtaɪzə(r)/ 重音在首音节。建议分角色跟读3遍，再尝试将 appetizer 换成 dessert 进行换词复述。

items.title: 《当幸福来敲门》The Pursuit of Happyness
items.body: 句段："Don’t ever let somebody tell you you can’t do something. Not even me. You got a dream, you gotta protect it. People can’t do something themselves, they wanna tell you you can’t do it. You want something, go get it. Period." 语言点：gotta = got to；wanna = want to；Period（美式口语）= 句号/到此为止，比 full stop 更地道，表终结与决心。连读训练："tell you you can’t" 中两个 you 需停顿清晰；"go get it" 连读为 /ɡoʊ ɡedɪt/。建议早晨洗漱时播放原片段跟读，培养美式语调节奏感。

items.title: 《阿甘正传》Forrest Gump
items.body: 句段："My mama always said: life was like a box of chocolates. You never know what you’re gonna get." 语言点：gonna = going to；mama（美式儿语/昵称，比 mother 更亲切）；引用长辈原话时保持过去式 was like。语音细节：box of /bɒks əv/ 中 of 弱读为 /ə/；gonna get 末尾 /t/ 可轻微喉塞音处理，更自然。延伸应用：可用 "X is like a box of chocolates — you never know what you’re gonna get" 比喻未知与惊喜，如 "Freelancing is like a box of chocolates — every project is different."
